transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hi, yeah, thanks. Um, I came in because I just feel like I absolutely cannot get my schoolwork and my little accessories shop organized at the same time. It's just... it's a total disaster right now. Like, my shop supplies, due dates, receipts, assignment notes—they all just end up in these massive piles everywhere in my room and I just stare at them and don't know what to do first. 

Which is so frustrating because I actually just bought these really gorgeous glass beads wholesale online for the shop, like a huge bulk order since they were on clearance, but the shipping took absolutely forever. And the mail carrier always leaves my packages at the wrong apartment door anyway, which is super annoying because my neighbor has this little terrier that literally barks at everything that moves, and I always have to sneak over there to grab my boxes before he starts yapping... wait, what was I saying? Oh, right, yeah, so I'm just here because everything is in piles and I'm totally overwhelmed with it all.
Did you have these kinds of focus and organization problems when you were a child, before age 12?

Yeah, definitely. Actually, my mom still has all these old notes from my elementary school teachers. She saves literally everything, it's kind of ridiculous. Like, her guest room closet is just stacked with bins of my old stuff. She even kept this one shoebox diorama I made in fourth grade of the solar system, but all the little styrofoam planets fell off the string, so it just looks like a dusty box of painted balls rolling around. I keep telling her to just throw it away because it's taking up so much space, but she gets so sentimental about every little thing. I don't know how she deals with all that clutter, it would drive me absolutely crazy. 

But um, anyway, the notes she kept from the teachers were always saying the exact same stuff. They'd write to her saying that I was always out of my seat, or that I kept blurting things out and talking before I was even called on. And they were always annoyed that I was rushing through all our group activities, which was so unfair because I actually understood the work! I just wanted to get it done and move on, you know? So yeah, I guess it's been happening since I was little.
